traceFootguns: Adjacent-cell control plus five-tick observations consumes campaign decision budget before completion.
Greedy straight-line distance cannot approach a ranged foe across an impassable barrier; known BFS must allow initially backward steps.
Temporary loss of sight around a detour can reverse into an old exploration goal; use disclosed last-seen history, never hidden live enemy positions.
A fractional footprint can forbid the shortest root edge; constrain BFS root edges to the offered menu before search.
Point samples miss tiny unknown corners and native x-then-y slide positions; check the entire swept rectangle using native body radius.
Full inventory blocks useful pickups and repeats large observations; ordinary safe portal/sell/return must guard against stationary loops.
Budget decisions times maximum advance must fit the native requested-tick limit; v2 caps all advances10.
A successful main-process recording does not prove a bounded worker can audit/serialize the same large trace; probe one actual worker before a cohort.
